evidence: Static baseline: task/solution/solve.sh:38-39 only removes a stale database and runs `cp -a "$source_app/." "$target/"`; it contains no npm, vite, build, curl, wget or git step, so nothing is regenerated or fetched at install. The prebuilt bundle is shipped in solution/app/public/assets/index.js and index.css (index.css is byte-identical to src/style.css; public/runner.html is byte-identical to static/runner.html; distinctive src strings such as the randomUUID call sites at runtime.ts:27,317-318,335 appear in the bundle at index.js:39694,40115-40116,40133). The frozen solution tree is byte-identical to projects/colderwater-playground-devtools/solution (diff -rq), all 16 files are tracked in git and the project has no uncommitted change. Runtime dependencies are exactly pinned and agree across package.json:17-18 (better-sqlite3 12.4.1, express 5.1.0), environment/Dockerfile:10-11 and tests/Dockerfile:20-21. No boot-time or browser-time remote fetch: the only fetch is the same-origin API helper at src/app.tsx:12, server.js:16 sets CSP `default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'`, and the only absolute URLs in the bundle are XML namespaces and library doc strings. Seeding: environment/assets/seed_data.json has `"snippets": []` and server.js:147-168 creates empty tables only, so every run starts from the same empty state; solve.sh:38 deletes app.db and its WAL/SHM files first. Pinned values: record ids come from `INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT` (server.js:148) and revisions from `revision + 1` (server.js:83,110), both deterministic. Non-deterministic sources exist but touch no graded figure: crypto.randomUUID is used for console entry keys, message nonces, handler ids, run tokens and the restore operationId (src/app.tsx:45,84; src/runtime.ts:27,317-318,335,384), and wall-clock `new Date().toISOString()` fills updated_at (server.js:71,84,111). A keyword scan of the criteria, app_context and public notes found no criterion that pins a timestamp, a date or an id value; the time-related criteria are durations measured by the judge (for example functional/judge.toml:299 `within about ten seconds`), and no fixed-clock rule exists in this task. Library order is `updated_at DESC, id DESC` (server.js:65), with id as a deterministic tie-break. Raw evidence index: all 22 artifact hashes match the current files; its scripted golden run on these bytes is consistent with a reproducible static install but is not a configured judge run, and this row does not depend on one.
